mapper.sql: record_id, user_id, record_type, title, content, record_date, mood, recall_enabled, rag_enabled, version, created_at, updated_at
record_id, user_id, record_type, title, LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(BTRIM(content), '[[:space:]]+', ' ', 'g'), 161) AS content, record_date, mood, recall_enabled, rag_enabled, version, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO personal_record ( user_id, record_type, title, content, record_date, mood, recall_enabled, rag_enabled ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{recordType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{recordDate}, #{mood}, #{recallEnabled}, #{ragEnabled} )
mapper.update: UPDATE personal_record SET record_type = #{recordType}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, record_date = #{recordDate}, mood = #{mood}, recall_enabled = #{recallEnabled}, rag_enabled = #{ragEnabled}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE record_id = #{recordId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND version = #{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL
